question: The radius of a solid lead sphere is 2 cm. 2541 such spheres are melted and recast into a cube of edge x cm. The value of x is (take π = (22)/(7)):
solution:
**Given:**

The radius of a solid lead sphere = 2 cm

The number of spheres = 2541

The edge of the cube = x cm

**Formula used:**

The volume of a sphere = (4/3)π(Radius)³

The volume of cube = (Edge)³

**Calculation:**

The volume of 2541 solid lead spheres = The volume of the cube

So, x³ = 2541 × (4/3) × (22/7) × 2³

⇒ x3 = 85184

⇒ x3 = 44³

⇒ x = 44

**∴ The value of x is 44 cm**
